name: claude-code-modified-by-nexalance
description: Codex-style prompt queue MANAGER for Anthropic's official Claude Code extension. Pure queue UI — no own chat. Pending prompts are auto-fed into your active Claude Code session via a Stop hook, so they only fire when the current turn is fully done.
author: Developer Jillur

commands.title: Fire the next pending prompt into Claude Code now
Probe macOS Accessibility (test or trigger the permission prompt)
Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation

claudeCodeModified.autoOpenOnStartup.description: Automatically open the Claude Mod sidebar every time VS Code starts, so you never have to hunt for the icon. Turn off if you find it intrusive.

claudeCodeModified.autoKickWhenIdle.description: When the queue has items and Claude appears idle, automatically push the head item into Claude's chat via osascript. Has the v0.2.18 verification safety net: if osascript paste succeeds but Claude Code's UserPromptSubmit hook doesn't fire within 5 seconds, the item is restored to the queue and a warning is shown. Turn off if you only want the Stop hook (decision:block+reason) drain path.

claudeCodeModified.enableNativeSubmit.description: When enabled, the Stop hook tries to paste each queued prompt into Claude's chat via osascript so it appears as a real user message. If osascript fails (no Accessibility permission, focus issues, etc.), automatically falls back to decision:block+reason which delivers reliably under the 'Stop hook feedback:' label. Off by default in v0.2.19 was the wrong call — re-enabled in v0.2.20.
